system.description:
You take your weapon as you rapidly Fire a swarm of shots into the sky before they begin to rain down up to your weapons range away, in a 15-foot radius sphere centered on a point of your choice. Each missile is tethered to you as your chakra is used as a binding chain.

Creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw taking your [Weapons damage] + 2d8, being Restrained by your chakra tethers pinning them in place. A Restrained creature can make a Strength saving throw, breaking free on a success.

Chain 1: Creatures who fail their saving throw are cut and sliced by the raining shots, gaining a rank of Bleeding.

Chain 2: A creature who fails this saving throw by 5 or more has their arms bound as well, losing the ability to form Hand Seals (HS), while Restrained.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8.
